model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart compares the accuracy percentages of different teaching methods across three subjects: Mathverse, MMU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage ranging from 50% to 62%, while the horizontal axis categorizes the subjects. Each bar is color-coded and patterned to represent a unique learning method: DAPO+ (blue with diagonal stripes), DAPO (green), SRPO (orange), GRPO (cyan), PPO (black), and PP0+Self-reflection (blue).
model_annotations.Chinese:
The chart is a vertical bar graph that compares the accuracy of different methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMO, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with increments of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three categories. Each method is represented by a unique color and pattern: DAPO+ (hatched cyan), DAPO (solid black), SRPO (striped orange), GRPO (solid orange), PPO+Self-reflection (diagonal red), and PPO (solid green).

The DAPO+ method shows varying accuracy across the categories, with the highest accuracy in Physics (around 58%) and the lowest in Mathverse (just above 52%). The DAPO method has a similar pattern, with the lowest accuracy in Mathverse (around 54%) and the highest in Physics (around 56%).

The SRPO method displays a consistent accuracy across all categories, with slightly higher accuracy in Physics (slightly above 56%) compared to Mathverse and MMO (both around 54%).

The GRPO method has its highest accuracy in Physics (around 58%) and lowest in Mathverse (around 54%), while the PPO+Self-reflection method shows a higher accuracy in Physics (around 61%) compared to Mathverse and MMO (both around 56%). The PPO method has the highest accuracy in Physics (around 61%) and the lowest in Mathverse (around 55%).
model_annotations.English: This bar chart depicts the accuracy rates of different prompting strategies over various subjects on a dataset. The chart has vertical axes that represent accuracy in percentage. There are axes rather than bars. Bars are categorized by subjects, labelled as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each bar represents an accuracy percentage for a specific prompting strategy. DAPO+ and SRPO have striped bars, ODLAPO and PP0 have dotted bars, pp+ChmO hNond has fine lined bars, m and Exped have dotted bars, and OhlapO has fine lined bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm repräsentiert den durchschnittlichen Trainingsfehler (F1-Score) verschiedener Trainingsmethoden in Übungen in drei verschiedenen Disziplinen: Mathematik, MMI U, und Physik zuzüglich. Die vertikale Achse wird als 1:5:3 dargestellt und zeigt den durchschnittlichen Trainingsfehler in Prozent, beginnend bei 50 bis hin zu über 60 prozentual. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Übungen unter Berücksichtigung der Disziplinenaufteilung dar und ist in drei Intervalle unterteilt: der erste Abschnitt mit dem Einplatzzahl von Mathe, MMI U und Physik von links nach rechts, da per Unterteilung auf eine einzelne Unterteilung gebracht wird. Der Mittensegment die einzige Unterteilung drei und vier Intervalle in den Übungen von MMI U und Physik. Abgesehen von der Unterscheidung zwischen dem männlichen und weiblichen Bildungszufindenbenutzergruppe, gibt es keine visuell angeordnete oder besonders hervorgehobene Zeile. Die Darstellungsverknüpfung beträgt pro relevantennieren Vergleich der Verfahren, damit pro relevantner Abschnitt.
